summary: Design handoff, not integrated. The prototype now has a slab-pack style pack page, a full-screen rip plus slot-reel opening with tier-scaled reveals, and simulated accounts, wallet deposits and Apple Pay, all in TEST MODE in the browser. API/auth integration is blocked: no network access from the agent, no combined preview, Supabase client not approved. The preview URL is a design-only artifact, not the combined Vercel preview.

cases.notes: UI still renders the 13 demo packs from browser data, not GET /api/packs. Blocked: agent cannot reach chef-pack-dev.vercel.app and there is no combined preview. Plan: render the 3 server packs and show the other themes as unavailable.

Sign-in and create-account screens exist but are simulated in localStorage (no passwords stored). Not connected to Supabase Auth: client library not approved, the Supabase host is not reachable from the agent, and preview redirect URLs aren't configured.
Opening is drawn in the browser (demo mode, marked in code). Not calling POST /api/orders yet. The reveal is already written to play back a given tier and value.
Idempotency-key persistence isn't implemented yet because there is no API call to retry.
Wallet is local per test account, not GET /api/wallet. Demo cards are labeled not redeemable but are not server inventory.
Server isolation is untested. Locally, a second test account saw none of the first account's cards or balance after sign out (observed in-session, not recorded as a file).
Offline, 401 and 503 handling not built; there are no API calls yet.

TEST MODE and NOT REDEEMABLE are visible on every screen and no real payment or provider calls are made (pass). But the browser demo invents tiers and upgrades, deducts a local balance, shows a $1.99 fee and a demo barcode, which this case forbids. These will be disabled in API mode, or kept only behind an explicit offline demo switch if Tyler agrees.

390px iPhone 13 and 1280px desktop: catalog → pack → reveal → wallet, no horizontal overflow, no console errors. Keyboard: Tab/Enter sign-in, open pack, buy, rip; Escape closes. Loading/error states for API calls do not exist yet, so they were not checked.
